world.h: Iran war: Blasts in Sanaa as Houthis warn Saudis
world.b: Al Jazeera live updates: blasts are heard in Sanaa as the Houthis threaten Saudi Arabia with a harsh response.
world.title: Blasts heard in Sanaa as Houthis threaten Saudi Arabia with harsh response

world.h: Houthis threaten Saudi Aramco sites and airports
world.b: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree called Saudi Aramco facilities and airports 'a legitimate target' after the Saudi-led coalition ordered civilians to evacuate an oil station in Sanaa.
world.title: Houthis threaten Saudi Arabia’s Aramco facilities and airports

world.h: Ex-DR Congo leader Kabila joins M23 in coalition
world.b: Former Congolese President Joseph Kabila launched a new political and military coalition that includes the Rwanda-backed M23 armed group, which has captured vast areas of eastern DR Congo.

world.h: Drone attack sinks ship off Bulgaria's coast
world.b: Two ships were hit in drone attacks off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast and one sank, Prime Minister Rumen Radev said. One was the Ukrainian-owned, Maltese-flagged Chelsea 3.
world.title: Drone attack sinks ship off Bulgaria’s Black Sea coast, PM says

world.h: Trump hedges on Netanyahu as Israel vote nears
world.b: Despite years of policies that buoyed Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, President Trump is hedging ahead of Israel's election.

world.h: Sudan's famine risk worsens, monitor warns
world.b: Conflict and El Niño-linked drought are worsening food insecurity across Darfur and Kordofan, including areas at risk of famine, the IPC food crisis monitor said.

world.h: NATO commander: alliance 'ready to fight tonight'
world.b: NATO's top military commander said the alliance is ready to fight if attacked, as European officials warn Russia could test its defenses with covert attacks or a limited incursion.

world.h: Zelenskyy: Russia still hitting energy sites
world.b: Zelenskyy said Russia kept striking Ukraine's energy facilities after Trump announced an energy ceasefire. He said Ukraine would honor such a deal if Moscow did the same.

world.h: Iran war: Saudi downs Houthi missiles
world.b: Al Jazeera live updates: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi missiles as deadly attacks continue in the Iran war.

world.h: Iran targets US-backed oil shuttle in Hormuz
world.b: Iran signalled it intends to disrupt an Arab-operated, US-assisted shuttle system that has moved more energy exports through the Strait of Hormuz during the war.

national.h: Scammers drain SNAP cards; Congress won't fund fix
national.b: ProPublica: organized gangs are stealing SNAP benefits with card skimmers. Most theft could be blocked by chip cards, but Congress won't fund the switch.
national.title: Scammers Are Stealing Millions From Food Stamp Recipients. Congress Could Fix It — but Won’t.

national.h: Pennsylvania inmates wait years on lawyers
national.b: ProPublica: underfunded, flat-fee post-conviction lawyers in Pennsylvania fell months or years behind, some leaving clients waiting as long as a decade.
national.title: He Waited Nine Years in Prison for His Lawyer to File a Single Brief. In This State, There’s No Rule Against It.

national.h: Erie mass shooting gunman and victims named
national.b: The Erie County coroner named Matthew Stone Sr., 45, as the gunman who killed eight people, including seven relatives, at a Pennsylvania home Friday before taking his own life.

national.h: Help for Christa Pike delayed after failed execution
national.b: 911 recordings show about half an hour passed before Tennessee prison officials confirmed an emergency call from the execution chamber after Christa Pike's failed lethal injection, the AP reports.
national.title: Emergency help for Christa Pike was delayed by confusion after failed execution, 911 calls reveal

national.h: Judge orders Trump to cancel taxpayer-funded TV ads
national.b: A federal judge in New York ordered the administration to cancel remaining TV ads paid for with taxpayer money to promote Trump's political message, siding with Common Cause and others.

politics.h: Guilfoyle resigns as ambassador to Greece
politics.b: Kimberly Guilfoyle resigned amid misconduct allegations, including claims she offered a donor access to officials for money. The White House said it had asked her to resign.
politics.title: US ambassador to Greece resigns amid misconduct allegations

politics.h: Supreme Court sides with Trump on DOGE records
politics.b: The Supreme Court intervened for a second time in CREW's lawsuit seeking records from Elon Musk's Department of Government Efficiency, siding with the administration.
politics.title: Supreme Court sides with Trump administration in lawsuit seeking records on Elon Musk’s DOGE

politics.h: Musk is biggest known midterm donor
politics.b: Elon Musk has given more than $276 million since July to try to save Republican majorities in Congress, including $158 million to the Senate Leadership Fund, his super PAC confirmed.

politics.h: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's home
politics.b: Homeland Security Investigations agents searched the Minnesota Democrat's home as part of a criminal investigation, the AP reported, citing two people familiar with the matter. Details were not immediately clear.

international.b: Yemen's internationally recognised government said it carried out nine air strikes on Houthi positions in Taiz governorate on Tuesday.
international.title: Yemeni government launches air strikes on Houthi positions

international.h: Sweden's Andersson fails again to form government
international.b: Social Democrat leader Magdalena Andersson said talks with the left-wing bloc hit an impasse, prolonging deadlock a month after elections.
international.title: Sweden’s centre-left leader fails in second bid to form government

international.h: Israeli forces raid Palestinian NGOs in West Bank
international.b: Israeli forces raided the offices of the Union of Palestinian Women's Committees and the Addameer prisoner rights group, and the courtyard of the Palestine Medical Complex.
Delhi police detained leaders of the youth-led 'cockroach' movement after they jumped barricades at a protest site, demanding the chief election commissioner resign over voter list revisions.

international.h: Imran Khan's PTI to fight Khyber takeover
international.b: Jailed ex-PM Imran Khan's party is preparing to fight Pakistan's emergency rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, which suspended the PTI-led provincial government.
international.title: Imran Khan’s PTI braces to fight federal takeover of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

international.h: Cyberattack spoils food at French supermarkets
international.b: A cyberattack on refrigeration systems at hundreds of French supermarkets pushed fridge temperatures as high as 50C (122F), spoiling food and causing fires. Intermarche, Cooperative U and E Leclerc confirmed the attack.

international.h: 100+ foreign trekkers stranded by Nepal floods
international.b: More than 100 foreign trekkers are stranded in Nepal's Gorkha district after flash floods washed away bridges, hiking trails and hundreds of homes, a local official said.

international.h: UK blames Iran for RAF airbase plot
international.b: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said a suspected plot targeting RAF Fairford was "almost certainly" directed by Iran's Revolutionary Guard. Britain sanctioned two Iranian nationals; Tehran denies involvement.

international.h: Ethiopian forces enter Tigray town of Adwa
international.b: Federal forces and an allied militia entered Adwa without a fight, residents said, a day after Tigray People's Liberation Front fighters withdrew.

international.h: Stolen Renoirs found behind wall in France
international.b: Two Renoir paintings stolen from a French museum last month were found damaged behind a false wall after six arrests, prosecutors said, ahead of a planned second heist.

international.h: Explosion in northern Israel kills teen on school trip
international.b: A 15-year-old on a school trip was killed and 19 others were injured in an explosion near the Lebanese border, officials said. The cause is under investigation.

business.b: The Social Security Administration announces next year's cost-of-living adjustment Wednesday morning. AARP predicts a 3.6% increase for 2027.
business.title: Social Security payments to increase — slightly

business.b: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford won the Nobel in economics for models that help governments and central banks manage shocks like energy crises and inflation.

business.h: Big bank earnings to show Fed hike's impact
business.b: JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo and Citigroup report third-quarter results Tuesday, offering a first look at how the Fed's rate hike is working through the economy.
business.title: Bank earnings this week could offer clues to impact of Fed's rate hike

science.h: Seabirds help keep coral reefs healthy
science.b: At Palmyra Atoll in the Pacific, scientists have found a surprising link between seabirds and the health of surrounding coral reefs.
science.title: One way to protect coral reefs? Bring back seabirds

science.h: Anthropic: small AI may soon self-replicate
science.b: Anthropic researchers said in a report Monday that small AI models may be months away from being able to self-replicate on consumer devices such as smart TVs and fridges, without a data centre.

sports.h: Dream, Valkyries set for WNBA Finals
sports.b: Atlanta and Golden State, neither of which has won a WNBA title, meet in the Finals starting Oct. 17. The Dream are 5-0 in the playoffs.
sports.title: 2026 WNBA playoffs bracket, schedule: Valkyries and Dream advance to WNBA Finals with semifinal sweeps

sports.b: CBS Sports' annual ranking of the NBA's top 100 players puts Victor Wembanyama at No. 1 entering the 2026-27 season.

sports.h: Bills beat Rams 37-34 in OT; punch thrown after
sports.b: Buffalo beat the Rams 37-34 in overtime Monday night. Afterward, Rams lineman Alaric Jackson threw an apparent punch at Bills pass-rusher Bradley Chubb.

sports.h: Brewers beat Dodgers 7-4 in NLCS Game 2
sports.b: Milwaukee topped Los Angeles 7-4 in Game 2 of the National League Championship Series.
sports.title: Milwaukee’s bullpen shines as the Brewers top the Dodgers 7-4 in NLCS Game 2

sports.h: SEC adopts uniform NIL and revenue-share contracts
sports.b: SEC presidents voted Monday to adopt standardized NIL and revenue-share contracts, effective immediately, making the SEC the second power conference to do so after the Big Ten.

sports.h: UCLA QB Iamaleava likely out for season
sports.b: UCLA quarterback Nico Iamaleava is expected to miss the rest of the season with a knee injury suffered in Saturday's 17-15 win over Oregon, CBS Sports reports.

sports.h: LSU's latest loss puts Kiffin on the spot
sports.b: Lane Kiffin harped on officiating after LSU's second loss in six games, but CBS Sports says questionable late-game decisions start with the coach.

sports.h: No NFC East team wins in Week 5
sports.b: CBS Sports' Week 5 grades give the Patriots and Packers an 'A+', while all four NFC East teams went winless, including the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Buccaneers.

sports.h: Commanders, Giants tie 27-27 after OT meltdown
sports.b: Washington ran out of time at the end of overtime with no timeouts, leaving the NFL's first tie of the season after Jayden Daniels went down with eight seconds left.

sports.h: Cardinals trade Marvin Harrison Jr. to Texans
sports.b: Houston sent a 2027 second-round pick and a 2027 sixth-rounder to Arizona for the 24-year-old receiver and a 2027 seventh-round pick.

sports.h: Eagles' Sirianni takes blame for London loss
sports.b: The Eagles lost their third straight, 19-17 to the Jaguars in London, after a controversial decision with eight seconds left. Coach Nick Sirianni accepted the blame.
Oregon committed seven turnovers in a 17-15 loss to UCLA, earning an 'F' on CBS Sports' Week 6 report card for contenders. Ohio State got a 'C+'.

sports.h: Georgia still SEC's king after Week 6
sports.b: CBS Sports' Week 6 overreactions: Kirby Smart's Georgia silenced Bryant-Denny Stadium, and Saturday delivered dramatic upsets and a shifted Big Ten hierarchy.

local.h: NY Public Radio CEO steps down after 8 months
local.b: Christy Tanner, who took over New York Public Radio in February, is stepping down. The organization gave no reason.
local.title: New York Public Radio CEO steps down after 8 months on job

local.h: Cyclist killed by ambulance on Staten Island
local.b: A cyclist riding the wrong way on Richmond Ave in Bulls Head was fatally struck by a turning ambulance Monday night, the NYPD said. The ambulance was not carrying a patient.
local.title: Cyclist dies in wrong-way crash with an ambulance on Staten Island

local.h: Hochul, Blakeman meet in lone governor debate
local.b: With the election three weeks away, Gov. Kathy Hochul and Republican Bruce Blakeman face off in their only debate.
local.title: With election 3 weeks away, Hochul and Blakeman to square off in lone NY governor debate

local.h: Taxi union, Uber seek driver healthcare
local.b: NYC's taxi union has teamed with Uber and a hedge fund to demand healthcare for drivers after four driver deaths.
local.title: NYC's taxi union teams with Uber, hedge fund demand healthcare after 4 driver deaths

local.b: Gov. Kathy Hochul declared a disaster emergency over the spread of measles in New York.
local.title: NY measles spread prompts 'disaster' emergency. It didn't have to be this way, health commissioner says.

local.h: Man shot by ICE still has bullet in neck
local.b: The man shot by ICE agents in New York City last week remained in solitary confinement at a Brooklyn federal lockup with a bullet lodged in his neck, his attorneys said.
local.title: Man shot by ICE in NYC still has bullet lodged in neck, attorneys say

local.h: Mamdani orders review of NYPD force policies
local.b: Facing criticism from the left over his approach to policing, Mayor Mamdani announced a comprehensive review of the NYPD's use of force policies.
local.title: Mayor Mamdani orders review of NYPD use of force policies

local.h: NYPD Bomb Squad contractor faced LI scrutiny
local.b: A company that won a $23 million contract to build an NYPD Bomb Squad building in the Bronx was flagged in a 2020 Nassau County inspector general report for not disclosing who ran the business.
local.title: Company that won $23M NYPD building contract was investigated by LI watchdog
